Definition: apparently from πῶρος (a kind of stone); to petrify, i.e. (figuratively) to indurate (render stupid or callous):-- blind, harden.
BiblicalUsage: Poroo means to harden, to petrify a heart until it cannot feel. Mark says the disciples' hearts were hardened when they saw the loaves, and John says God blinded eyes and hardened hearts so they would not see. Paul says the rest of Israel were blinded, and the writer to the Hebrews says their minds were blinded when the old covenant is read.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a hard heart is not born in a day; it is built choice by choice until it cannot feel at all. That frightens me, and it makes me pray for a soft heart while there is still time.
